entities.summary: Rajendran Absolem Christie was an Indian former field hockey player. He was the goalkeeper of the Indian hockey team that won the gold medal in the 1964 Summer Olympics at Tokyo, Japan, and the bronze medal in the 1968 Summer Olympics at $1Mexico City$2, Mexico, Mexico. They also won the silver medal in the 1962 Asian Games at Jakarta, Indonesia.
